elements.element: Renewal by mutual written agreement OR automatic 12-month renewals (preferred structure)
elements.evidence: "automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date"

elements.element: Customer may opt out of automatic renewal on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: "unless terminated by the Company upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI"
"HDI shall notify the Company in writing of each upcoming automatic renewal not less than sixty (60) days prior to the applicable anniversary"

elements.element: Renewal price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: No price-increase or CPI language anywhere in the rendered clause; official check: "preferred automatic renewal includes the lesser-of-CPI-and-3% price cap" — not met
"shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period"

elements.element: Customer non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days
elements.evidence: "by the Company upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI" (30 ≤ 60)
Clause contains no cap on renewal pricing; nothing in "4.1 Term; Termination" addresses fees on renewal

offending_extra_words: or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice to the Company
reasons: Preferred level incomplete: the opt-out (30 days) and the 60-day Vendor reminder are both present, but the mandatory renewal price cap at the lesser of CPI and 3% is entirely absent, so the locked preferred bargain is not completed.

Fallback level also incomplete on its own terms: the ≤60-day notice window is satisfied (30 days) but the ≤5% renewal price-increase cap is missing. The playbook's precision position requires stating the cap for automatic renewal even where the original is silent, so this is not a condition that is demonstrably absent.

Minimality fails: operation 1 expands 32 words to 69 (ratio 2.16), rewriting the whole termination sentence and restating HDI's untouched 90-day right when a targeted edit (e.g. replacing "either Party hereto upon ninety (90)" with party-specific notice periods) plus a short separate insertion for the reminder would suffice.

Fix: (i) narrow the rewrite so HDI's existing 90-day right is left untouched rather than restated, and (ii) add a short sentence capping any renewal fee increase at the lesser of CPI and 3% (5% if falling back) to complete the level.

Intent is preserved: the Effective Date mechanic, one-year initial term, automatic renewal and the "Termination Date" definition all remain effective, and no undefined term or dangling cross-reference is introduced.
